goal: Separate the preparation team's internal cost calculation from the market department's estimate result, while reusing indexed Obsidian supplier evidence and never exposing internal pricing details on the market-facing surface.

scope.source_of_truth: NAS projects/供应商价格库 archived with an Obsidian business note and indexed in data/nas_memory.db

acceptance_criteria.description: The Office menu routes 物料报价, 筹备组物料报价, and 报价系统 directly to one shared web/native H5 workspace containing a preparation-team calculation surface and a distinct market estimate-result surface without invoking an LLM.
The preparation-team surface can add and remove material rows, enter specification, quantity, unit, unit price, supplier, item remarks, and price evidence, and always shows missing prices as 待询价.

The preparation-team surface can deterministically match indexed Obsidian price-table rows and return item, specification, unit, historical unit price, supplier, source path, and review status without calling a model.
Item subtotal, loss, transport, installation, rush fee, profit, tax, pre-tax total, and grand total are recalculated server-side from normalized decimal inputs.

Saving a valid estimate recalculates the amount server-side and patches a market-facing estimate-result card without enqueuing an LLM task; the result contains only project context, final estimate, validity, and estimate status.

The preparation-team calculation surface can generate and download a real internal Excel workbook whose first worksheet follows the reference-style nine-column cost list (序号、礼品/物料组合、规格、数量、单位、单价、小计、图示、备注), keeps formula-driven fee rows and a grand total, and retains supplier and historical-price traceability on a separate worksheet; that workbook is never linked from the market-facing result card.

The market estimate produces real Word and PDF deliverables containing only project, client or brand, final estimate, validity, estimate status, and public notes; internal material, supplier, source, unit-cost, cost-breakdown, and profit fields are absent.
After the market estimate exists, users may explicitly sync the sanitized market result to a Feishu cloud document; sync is optional, never automatic, and does not expose internal calculation fields.

The quotation tool home exposes a separate employee supplier-price intake with manual single-item and multi-item rows plus an optional source-file upload; this intake does not require creating a project estimate.

Employee-entered supplier prices and original evidence are archived to the mounted NAS, mirrored as need-review Obsidian supplier notes, and immediately indexed in data/nas_memory.db; a missing historical unit stays empty and must be completed instead of being displayed as 待确认.

Every Feishu quotation-tool card uses the NAS LAN H5 origin during the internal pilot and the same domestic HTTPS origin as the unified workbench after domain cutover; switching DC_ASSISTANT_H5_ORIGIN does not change H5 routes or publish an employee-Mac address.

The NAS assistant process silently records only timestamp, source IP, method, status code, and service name for H5 requests, without recording capability URLs, query strings, request bodies, or quotation data.

Each material row accepts either one image or a batch of up to six validated images in one selection, shows working local thumbnail previews with click-to-enlarge lightbox viewing, archives every image to the mounted NAS knowledge share, and lays all selected images out in that row's Excel 图示 cell; every generated quotation revision is mirrored with a manifest under projects/筹备组物料报价/<draft>/v<version> while images remain in the sibling images directory.

network_access.shared_origin: http://192.168.1.35:6185 during LAN phase; HTTPS origin configured by DC_ASSISTANT_H5_ORIGIN after domain cutover
network_access.ingress: NAS LAN forward during phase 1; Tencent Cloud domestic reverse tunnel after domain cutover

calculation_policy.missing_price: 待询价，不计入当前合计
calculation_policy.market_result_gate: 待询价数量必须为 0，才能生成并发送市场部估价结果

supplier_price_intake.entry: 报价工具首页 / 新增合作公司价格
supplier_price_intake.unit_policy: 单位使用含印刷、广告制作、搭建常用口径的下拉列表；历史资料未记录时保持空白并要求员工选择

quotation_archive.image_policy: Single or batch PNG, JPEG, or WebP input; up to 6 images per material and 10 MB per image; server-normalized PNG; embedded only in the internal Excel workbook

verification.targeted: uv run pytest tests/test_material_quotation.py tests/test_material_quotation_delivery.py tests/test_supplier_price_intake.py tests/test_assistant_attachment_upload.py tests/dc_router/test_assistant_workbench.py tests/harness/test_feishu_material_quotation_contract.py -q
